fee_notes: Standard fee is $25,000. Existing franchisees in good standing adding a new start-up location pay $1,000. Converting an existing wireless retail operation pays $1,000. Veterans (honorably discharged) receive 50% discount on standard fee. In 2025, fees granted ranged from $0 to $1,000.
raw_excerpt: You will pay us an initial franchise fee which varies from $25,000 to $1,000 based on your level of experience in the wireless and wireline sales industry and/or the location of your Store. In 2025, we granted franchises with initial franchise fees ranging from $0 to $1,000.
